last_verdict: MIXED — H1 supported: kernel is deterministic exact-intent matcher (L97) with no URL template analysis, confirmed for complex aliasing types (query-param, path-rewriting, server-side routing) at equal confidence 0.9, n=6 aliased-first conditions (0/6 correct, binomial p=0.016). H2 falsified-in-setting: HTTP status-code grounding provides zero autonomous signal on jsonplaceholder.typicode.com (0/12 status differences across 12 aliased conditions; substrate returns 200 for malformed templates like /posts?id=1/comments). Body-based grounding is an exploratory non-autonomous finding (4/4 body differences in asymmetric scenarios B and C, but requires external oracle to determine correctness, produces false positives for equivalent templates in A and F). Experiment does not meet SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST per frozen decision rule condition (4): for asymmetric scenarios B and C, HTTP execution per frozen status-code definition correctly identifies valid template in 0/4 cases, not 100%.
